panels.title: ABOUT
panels.text: **Synthwerk** is a set of small services for AI chat, image recognition and page building. You run all of it yourself. This repo is the map. It contains no service. It is very good at that.

items.text: Each part is a separate repo `synthwerk-<role>`. This repo is the map.
Drop the widgets into a website, or build your own app with the SDK.
In development, models run on your machine. No paid AI provider is needed. Self-hosted.
The blueprint, the design tokens and the vision classifier. The other services are planned or in rewrite.

`docker compose up` arrives with milestone M1.

panels.caption: Trunk-based. No env branches. One image, built once, promoted by digest.

items.text: There are no environment branches. One image is built once and promoted by digest.
Every repo calls the blueprint workflows at `@v1` and uses the same README and feature-doc layout.
APIs and events are defined in `synthwerk-contracts`. Clients are generated from it.
The llm service reads the other services through read-only MCP tools.
No service deploys yet. This flow is the target for milestone M1 and later.
The full ecosystem diagram is in `docs/architecture.md`.

rows.text: Shared CI workflows, lint configs, templates, feature-doc skill. YAML, JS. **v1.0.0 released.**
npm packages. Design tokens now, SDK later. TypeScript. **tokens 0.2.0.**
Image labels with an open vocabulary and a topic tree. Python. **Working.**
Orgs, roles, entitlements, paywall. Login by Zitadel. Go. **Rewrite planned.**
LLM gateway, streaming chat, mascot binary. Go. **Rewrite planned.**
Embeddable chat and vision widgets. Vue 3.5. **Rewrite planned.**
Public site, page builder, admin, live health. Nuxt 4. **Rewrite planned.**
OpenAPI, event schemas, generated clients. OpenAPI, JSON Schema. **Planned.**
Servers, compose stack, edge, repo settings. OpenTofu. **Planned.**
Health, audit log, KPIs over SSE. Go. **Planned.**
End-to-end tests across all services. Playwright. **Planned.**

items.text: The repo has a new README. The old code is kept at the tag `legacy-final`.
The repo does not exist yet. It has no link below.
One loader script on your page gives chat and vision widgets plus sign-in. Settings live in studio. Ready at milestone M2 (planned).
Your own app on the same services with `@synthwerk/react` or `@synthwerk/vue`, and `@synthwerk/tokens`. Tokens now. SDK at milestone M5 (planned).
AI calls need a signed-in user. Passkeys and MFA. Both ways use the same accounts and roles.
The loader script and the SDK packages do not exist yet.
Development uses local models. Vision runs on CPU with ONNX and calls no external API.
Strobe is a no-login helper on the website. It has no tools, no database and no network egress. It uses a local model only. The name is not final.

items.lead: Scope on the token, not the prompt
items.text: Each service checks the scope in the user's token. A prompt cannot change access.
Services publish facts as CloudEvents on NATS. Questions use HTTP.
Chat and vision need a signed-in user. Only the mascot is public.

rows.text: **Clean slate.** In progress. Old names removed. Blueprint CI green in a repo.
**Spine runs locally.** Planned. `docker compose up` starts edge, bus, database, telemetry, pulse.
**Chat slice on dev.** Planned. A passkey user gets streamed answers in an embedded chat.
**MVP on prd.** Planned. The approved stg build runs on prd. Restore drill done.
**Public demo.** Planned. Public site with live chat, vision and the mascot.
**Paid plans and SDK apps.** Planned. Checkout changes entitlements. App templates for React and Vue.
**Cluster-ready.** Planned. Same images on k3s. Security review closed. Card scan works.
Targets are estimates. Estimates are not promises. This line is.
